description: Replace the markdown, title, style or message of a draft. Only drafts can be changed; to change a sent document, void it and create a new one. Returns preview_url, a 7-day link to show your human the document and compare styles.

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

external_reference.description: Your own ID for this document (e.g. a CRM deal or invoice number). Returned in responses and webhooks.

message.description: Short personal note from the sender.

metadata.description: Your own key/value details for this document, e.g. {"customer_number": "C-1001", "job_number": "J-77", "quote_number": "Q-310"}. Flat object, up to 20 keys (starting with a letter or _, then letters, numbers, _ or -), text or number values up to 500 characters, stored as text. Returned in responses and webhooks; find documents by it with list_documents metadata. Replaces the whole object; null clears it.

sender_role.description: Optional role shown on the sender's signature, e.g. "Client" or "Director". Used with sender_signs=true.

sender_signs.description: true adds a signature field for the sender (the account holder, using their name and email); false removes it. Only for two-sided agreements (services/contractor agreements, mutual NDAs, leases, partnerships). Never for quotes, proposals, consents, acknowledgements, waivers or one-way NDAs, where only the recipient signs. Check validation.signing_advice and ask the human if unsure.

style.description: Visual style for the email and signing page. Overrides the md2sign:style directive. Default classic.

title.description: Document title shown to signers. Defaults to the md2sign:title directive or the first # heading.

verify_signers.description: Team plans: true makes every signer confirm a one-time code emailed to them before their signature is recorded (adds <!-- md2sign:verify=email -->); false turns it off for this document even when the account verifies signers by default (verify=none). Omit to use the account default.

name: update_draft
title: Update a draft document
